# Search for hotels in Anchorage with 2-star rating
from tools import search_hotels, filter_hotels, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached hotel results to apply 2-star filter
hotel_results = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Filter hotels by 2-star rating
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    stars=[2, 2]
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels_2star", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for nearest tourist attractions in Anchorage
from tools import search_attractions, search_nearest

attractions = search_attractions(city="Anchorage", type=["Tourist"])

# Find nearest attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save nearest attractions to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

print("No planning needed")
